verdict.rationale: Airweave offers webhooks that push real-time event notifications (sync completed, connection created, collection updated) rather than a true rule engine where users define conditional triggers that automatically execute actions inside the product; actual automation logic must be built externally (e.g., via Pipedream workflows) that consume these events. missing for 10: a native rule/trigger-condition builder, support for user-defined conditional logic, and evidence of actions being executed automatically by Airweave itself rather than just notifying external systems.
